formName: Deeper Intimacy Advanced Tantrik Temple form
question: Have you been in a Tantric Temple before? Kindly share a bit.
answer: Every time was a very different experience. Last time I danced with someone I felt instant chemistry with from the moment we saw each other. It went really well and quite early she undressed and wanted to give me a massage. Suddenly she got triggered and needed some time for herself, apparently she went faster than she could handle. It was a strange feeling… It wasn’t me who wanted to go that fast, but still she got triggered. There was nothing I could really do about it, so I couldn’t blame myself. It started so quickly and suddenly I was alone while everyone was enjoying themselves… But a few moments later I got the offer from a couple to go to the massage corner together, not what I expected. It was really an amazing experience, and the whole time I felt like we were doing something that was illegal, but afterwards I learned that there was literally nobody who thought this except for me. Best thing of all: I expected to do Shibari that night, I recently learned it and wanted to put it in action… but faith decided and I never got to the Shibari corner. This thought me that you can never know what the temple will bring.

answer: Eight years ago, I took two training courses (the Columbus and the Mandela at Corinor). The training focuses on (un)utilized potential. Since these courses, I know I can no longer look outside myself and that everything I find says something about me and nothing about anyone else, for example. question:
Contents of the program (Scale 1-5)

(What is your experience of the program regarding pace, presence, creativity, contents, space holding, etc)
answer: I loved that we started with ecstatic dance to really arrive in the body and so much fun too! I think the shamanic journey gave the day that element of sacredness and connecting with the cycles in life, both in nature as in our own life. Very beautiful element to have on such a day I feel. The guidance flowing from the shamanic journey into the temple for me was the least clear and least well guided moment of the day. The elements itself were beautifully held with a lot of presence and loving space holding. But that transition felt a bit off to me and was hard to follow what was happening and what we were supposed to do. I loved that all elements had a good amount of time. I think the Shamanic Journey deserved a little more time even.

question: Name (or anonymous)
We're curious of your experience! How was it? In general, and also specifically with the Ecstatic Dance, Shamanic Journey, and Temple.
answer: Overall it was a beautiful, powerful and deep experience for me. The Ecstatic Dance was truly amazing, I was able to go deep into my body, my emotions and loved the flow of the music. During the Shamanic Journey I didn't find a place to really extend my body fully. Either there weren't enough mattresses or we weren't distributed evenly over the space but that made it hard for me to relax and sink into it as my body was not comfortable. But the content of the journey was still meaningful and I got some insights. The temple started a bit unclear to me with how the exercise was introduced and done. But then the temple afterwards was a very beautiful experience for me.

question: Shamanic journey~ curious of you experience! How was it and what came through the journey?What medicines, insights, gifts were there?
answer: As said above, I wasn't able to go as deep as I wanted/hoped. Nevertheless it was very healing to look at my past self (the many different versions) and see how far I've come and what a journey my soul is making in this lifetime. Sometimes I felt it went a bit quick, I hadn't fully visualized the various steps yet (probably also because I was distraced by not being fully in it) but then we went quite quickly through the steps.

question: Others (Aryiana, Paulo and/or Bart)
answer:
Bart played an amazing DJ set and both guided as well as followed the flow of the group, which I think is really important in ecstatic dance. Overall the musical guidance throughout the day was really supportive. 
As said above, the space holding team in essence I think did a wonderful job giving the space a safe and held feeling while not being in the center of attention themselves. Small room for improvement is maybe that at the beginning, when Sandi did the talk, I felt it didn't show much presence and interest when Paulo was lying down. I think that begin part of the day is important to show that you're open for the participants to come to you and that lying down didn't feel so welcoming.

question:
We plan to offer more editions in time to come.

Would you be with us again?

(If so, could share your suggestions for season, location and duration)
Is there anything left you want to share?
answer: The only thing that I somehow missed at the beginning of the day was a round of names / intention. I understand you maybe wanted to make it less formal and not so much words. But I always like by saying the names out loud you also really bring your energy in the space and we can create a sense of community a bit faster. Intention can only be 1 word or maybe just sharing 1 word of what's alive in us at that moment. By not being in a circle but all spread over the matresses it was a bit more as if we're watching a 'show' at the front of the stage rather than being literally at the start of a shared experience as a group. But this is my personal preference. It was also refreshing to see how it can be done differently too ;-) In the end it also worked as I think the day gave beautiful connections.

question: Sandi
answer: Sandi: i love your presence and guidance, very spiritually connected and grounded at the same time. I could feel your love for the work, the group and the divine throughout all the day. Space for improvement I think is sometimes speaking too softly / making yourself small. In a way that made it less professional at times than i think was needed, as you are a pro and got what it takes. So you may own that. And maybe sometimes be a little more clear in what we're supposed to do, as the group if of course of mixed 'levels' of experience and so it makes it even more important to make sure everyone is able to follow.
